summary: Cold SRanger codegen: 8 files, 3 modes, 7 required transitions plus a Final tick self-loop. Six review items.

issues.title: Moving->Turning: obstacle event AND obstacleDetected guard
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 triggers on the obstacle event; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected (distance <= obstacleThreshold) guards the same transition.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented as trigger Obstacle with guard obstacleDetected. If the guard is meant to be informational only, drop '&& obstacleDetected'.

issues.title: Final mode has a tick self-loop
issues.raw: SR-FR3 makes Final terminal with no listed transitions; the codegen rules require every mode to have an outgoing transition.
issues.fix_directive: Added a no-action Tick self-loop in FINAL (never leaves Final). Remove if Final must refuse all events.

issues.title: Move output realised as Actuator.move(lv, av)
issues.raw: SR-DM4 describes Move as an output event with two reals.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented as a two-argument actuator call (an operation in RoboChart terms, as in the original SRanger model) rather than a two-field event record.

issues.title: Clock time base is seconds; accessor named nowMs()
issues.raw: SR-Var1/SR-DM2 give clockResetTime and turnDuration in seconds; the pipeline clock convention uses clock.nowMs().
issues.fix_directive: Clock.nowMs() returns seconds (documented) so turnDuration stays 2.0; controller field is 'timer' to avoid the reserved word 'clock'.

issues.title: Initial Move(moveVel, 0) issued in constructor
issues.raw: SR-FR1: on entering Moving issue Move(moveVel,0); Moving is initial (SR-Beh1).
issues.fix_directive: The constructor issues the initial forward Move. Transition priority: endTask first in every mode; in Turning the timed exit precedes the tick self-loop.

issues.title: No-reading distance default = 1000000.0 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 requires 'a large default value' without a number.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor returns 1000000.0 m until the first update; negative readings are clamped to 0.

next_step: Run the pipeline; revisit these choices only if a verifier implicates them.
